name: packet_validate
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
lane=Path.cwd();r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());p=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text());reserved=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(map(int,r))==set(reserved) and len(r)==20
for x in p:
 i=x['id'];raw=Path(f'provenance/{i}.raw.jsonl').read_bytes();tok=Path(f'provenance/{i}.statement-token.json').read_bytes();dec=Path(f'provenance/{i}.statement.txt').read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(tok).hexdigest()==x['token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(dec).hexdigest()==x['decoded_sha256'];assert json.loads(tok)==dec.decode()==r[str(i)]['literal_statement'];assert raw.endswith(b'\n')==x['newline']
for x in json.loads(Path('source-inventory.json').read_text()):assert hashlib.sha256(Path(x['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];b=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and b['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
for j,c in enumerate(charges,1):
 assert c['queries']==json.loads(Path(c['plan']).read_text())['queries'];assert hashlib.sha256(Path(c['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c['plan_sha256'];assert len(json.loads(Path(f'search{j}-response.json').read_text()))>1000
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(lane.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 x=json.loads(f.read_text());assert x['exit']==0 and x['killed'] is None;receipts.append({'path':f.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'wall_s':x['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':x['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':x['child_cpu_cumulative_s'],'samples':x['samples']})
inv=json.loads(Path('resource-inventory.json').read_text());inv['completed_receipts_at_inventory_time']=receipts;inv['future_terminal_receipts']='packet_validate.receipt.json/output.txt are created after this inventory and included in final manifest; final_manifest.receipt.json/output.txt precisely excluded as terminal noncircular artifacts.'
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'resource-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(inv,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
v={'twenty_keys':True,'raw_token_decoded_bindings':len(p),'source_payload_hashes':7,'search_live_continuity':True,'completed_wrapper_receipts':len(receipts),'completed_wrapper_failures':[],'candidate_count':0,'credit':0,'limits':'Documentary validation only; not independent mathematical validation.'}
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'packet-validation.json'],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0;print(json.dumps(v))
